_comment_READ_ME_FIRST: IMPORTANT — read this before using this template. As of launch, site/index.njk (the front-gate page) does not yet read site/_data/seasonal.json at all: adding an entry here will NOT change anything a visitor sees until a developer wires up the front-gate template to pick an active seasonal entry and swap in its background/outfit/welcome line/animation. This template exists so the data shape is ready and agreed on ahead of that work (see DECISIONS_AND_GAPS.md, 'Not a gap: seasonal entrances'). If Barb wants a seasonal entrance built, that's a real feature request for a developer session, not something her desktop assistant can turn on by itself by editing this file.
label: Human-readable name, e.g. 'Winter Holidays'
_comment_active: must stay false until the front-gate feature described above actually exists — this field is reserved for that future switch
_comment_dateRange: the month-day range this entrance would be shown, if the feature existed
_comment_backgroundImage: an image id from site/_data/images.json for the front-gate background
_comment_baronessOutfitImage: an image id from site/_data/images.json showing the Baroness in a seasonal outfit — never invent an outfit or appearance detail that isn't in an actual approved image
_comment_welcomeLine: a seasonal front-gate welcome line in the Baroness's voice — like the regular welcome line, this must be logged in COPY_REVIEW.md for Barb's approval and never treated as canon until she approves it
_comment_animationDescription: one gentle, describable animation only (per CLAUDE_CODE_START_HERE.txt) — must respect prefers-reduced-motion with a static fallback, and must never change navigation, labels, focus order, contrast, or layout
